label: has execution constraint
type: a topology or placement constraint on where the subject may execute - e.g. every statement in a SQL++ transaction must be routed to the same Query node.
note: Promoted with a deliberately narrow range (execution topology/placement only) because the name is broad enough to attract anything: a future agent will read 'execution constraint' as a home for timeouts, memory quotas and privilege checks, all of which have their own predicates. If it starts collecting those, rename it rather than widening it. Load-bearing as written: the node-affinity constraint is the reason transaction state cannot be assumed to survive a reconnect.
